_comment: Tier-2 for dune::mixed_methods#1 (the Python factory is raviartThomas, camelCase). RE-POINTED 2026-08-06: this fixture was keyed to mixed_methods#0, which is now the RT-in-product() CompileError claim; the camelCase claim sits at index 1. Pitfall indices are positional and this is exactly the drift test_dune_verified_api warns about. Original note follows. Tier-2 for dune::mixed_methods#0 (LBB-stable RT_k + DG-P_k pair). DUNE's Python factory for Raviart-Thomas H(div) elements is raviartThomas (camelCase), not raviartthomas (lowercase). The C++ header IS lowercase ('raviartthomas.hh'), which is where catalog confusion came from — but 'from dune.fem.space import ...' exposes the camelCase Python wrapper. Catalog had the lowercase form in 3 places: src/backends/dune/generators/advanced.py L592 (import), L608 (call), and __init__.py L40 (description). Catalog falsification #28 found via the new dune_source_scanner.py walking the installed DUNE-fem source tree (runtime import is broken by libibverbs ABI conflict, task #15). Asserts (a) raviartThomas camelCase def is in _spaces.py, (b) lowercase def is NOT, (c) the lowercase .hh include literal IS present in _spaces.py text (provenance for the confusion), (d) the catalog has 0 remaining lowercase occurrences. Verified empirically 2026-06-01. Physics name was previously 'mixed_poisson' (non-existent on dune); corrected to 'mixed_methods' 2026-06-02 to link fixture to the real pitfall via the scanner. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 appends a synthetic 'def raviartthomas(' line to the in-memory copy of _spaces.py, i.e. the world in which dune-fem ships a lowercase alias. The file on disk is never touched. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'raviartthomas_lowercase_def_present=False' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
